demo_note: Synthetic demo config for examples/custom_predictions.jsonl (not paper data).

notes.Clean: optional baseline arm for sanity checks; not required for W
notes.time: integer inclusive frame indices on the original video
notes.boxes: absolute-pixel xywh; out-of-frame boxes are scored as-is (no extra clip)
notes.fixed_GT: pair_rows must contain spatial predictions on the GT candidate grid before temporal filtering
